backlog.spec: Add all RDKit Descriptors.descList values (nan_to_num, clip to ±1e6) as features concatenated with the Morgan bits, keep the RF. Crippen logP and TPSA should help logD strongly.
backlog.title: RDKit 2D descriptors + RF

backlog.spec: Replace the model with LightGBM (n_estimators 800, lr 0.03, num_leaves 31, colsample 0.5, subsample 0.8, seed) on RDKit descriptors only (nan_to_num).
backlog.title: Descriptors only LightGBM

backlog.spec: Use GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy with radius 2 and 2048 bits instead of binary bits; keep the RF.
backlog.title: Count Morgan fingerprints

backlog.spec: Concatenate RDKit descriptors with count Morgan (radius 2, 1024 bits) and fit LightGBM with lr 0.03, 1000 trees, colsample 0.3, min_child_samples 10, L1 objective.
backlog.title: Descriptors + count Morgan + LightGBM

backlog.spec: Use CatBoostRegressor (iterations 1500, depth 6, lr 0.05, loss MAE, thread_count 8, random_seed=seed, verbose 0) on RDKit descriptors plus count Morgan 1024 bits.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: In the GBM model, switch the objective to huber or L1 since the metric is MAE; compare with L2 on the descriptor features.
backlog.title: MAE objective for GBM

backlog.spec: Average predictions of the RF on Morgan bits and a LightGBM on descriptors plus counts, with weights 0.4/0.6.
backlog.title: RF + GBM blend

backlog.spec: Append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys) to the features of the baseline RF.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys

backlog.spec: Add hashed atom-pair count fingerprints (1024 bits) from rdFingerprintGenerator to the Morgan features, then use RF or LightGBM.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion count fingerprints

backlog.spec: Use count Morgan radius 3 with 4096 bits, with chirality off, and RF max_features 0.2.
backlog.title: Larger Morgan radius 3 counts

backlog.spec: Add functional-class invariants Morgan fingerprints (GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen) radius 2, 1024 bits counts, to the standard Morgan features.
backlog.title: Feature-class Morgan (FCFP)

backlog.spec: Replace RF with ExtraTreesRegressor (500 trees, max_features 0.3, min_samples_leaf 1) on descriptors plus Morgan bits.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees

backlog.spec: Compute Tanimoto kernel on count Morgan fingerprints (minmax kernel) and fit SVR with precomputed kernel, C=5, epsilon 0.1, centering target by the mean.
backlog.title: SVR with Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Fit KernelRidge with a precomputed minmax kernel on count Morgan (alpha 0.3), and average with a descriptor LightGBM.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge Tanimoto + GBM blend

backlog.spec: Standardize the descriptors (QuantileTransformer), then fit an sklearn MLPRegressor (256,128, early_stopping, alpha 1e-3) and average 5 seeds. Blend 50% with a GBM.
backlog.title: Standardized descriptors MLP

backlog.spec: Train 5 LightGBM models with different seeds, subsample 0.7 bagging, and average, to reduce variance.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged GBM

backlog.spec: Use XGBRegressor (hist, 800 trees, depth 6, lr 0.03, colsample_bytree 0.4, subsample 0.8, reg:absoluteerror) on descriptors plus MACCS.
backlog.title: XGBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Stack RF, LightGBM, CatBoost and SVR using out-of-fold predictions from an inner 5-fold CV, with a Ridge meta-learner, inside fit_predict.
backlog.title: Stacking ensemble

backlog.spec: Remove features with fewer than 5 nonzero training molecules and constant descriptors before fitting, to speed up and reduce noise.
backlog.title: Drop low-variance features

backlog.spec: Add features: sum of Crippen per-atom logP contributions and MR contributions binned by atom type (rdMolDescriptors._CalcCrippenContribs), plus the TPSA surface contributions, to the descriptors.
backlog.title: Crippen contributions per atom

backlog.spec: Add counts of acidic and basic groups (carboxylic acid, tetrazole, sulfonamide NH, aliphatic amines, amidines, pyridine, imidazole) via SMARTS, as logD depends on ionization. Append to descriptors and use LightGBM.
backlog.title: Ionization-aware SMARTS features

backlog.spec: Clip train targets to the 1st and 99th percentiles before fitting, to reduce outlier influence under the MAE metric.
backlog.title: Target clipping and winsorize

backlog.spec: Set the RF min_samples_leaf to 2 and max_features to 0.2, N_TREES 500, on descriptors plus Morgan counts.
backlog.title: RF tuned min_samples_leaf and max_features

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, keep the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralize charges with Uncharger, so that features are consistent.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and neutralization

backlog.spec: Skip: implement instead a simple Weisfeiler-Lehman atom-environment feature using Morgan counts with a bit-folded 512 size, and train an sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor (loss absolute_error) on it plus descriptors.
backlog.title: Chemprop-like message passing in numpy

backlog.spec: Fit a GaussianProcess-like model: SVR with RBF kernel (C=3, gamma scale) on standardized, quantile-transformed descriptors, and blend with the GBM at 0.3/0.7.
backlog.title: Gaussian process on descriptors

backlog.spec: Train separate LightGBMs on (a) descriptors, (b) count Morgan, (c) atom-pair counts, and average the predictions equally.
backlog.title: Rank-average multi-featurizer ensemble

backlog.spec: Use LightGBM with lr 0.01, 3000 trees, num_leaves 15, feature_fraction 0.3, lambda_l2 5, min_child_samples 15 on descriptors plus count Morgan.
backlog.title: Lower learning rate longer GBM

backlog.spec: Hold out 10% of train molecules grouped by Murcko scaffold inside fit_predict, use for early stopping in LightGBM, then predict with best iteration (average over 3 splits).
backlog.title: Scaffold-aware inner early stopping

backlog.spec: Compute Crippen MolLogP, fit a linear regression of y on it, and train the GBM on the residuals using descriptors plus Morgan counts; add the linear prediction back.
backlog.title: Predict residual from Crippen logP

incumbent.description: Cache per-molecule features, since the same 3360 molecules are re-featurized with 210 RDKit descriptors in every one of the 15 fits. Also use 3 inner stacking folds instead of 5, so each fit trains 5 sets of models instead of 6.
